thread.title: Apple iPhone XR Preorders Called 'Mildly Disappointing' | Investor's Business Daily

author: PATRICK SEITZ
title: Apple iPhone XR Preorders Called 'Mildly Disappointing' | Investor's Business Daily
text:
Wall Street's early read on Apple ( AAPL ) iPhone XR preorders is that the midrange handset is selling slightly weaker than expected.
X Apple began taking preorders for the iPhone XR last Friday . The 6.1-inch LCD-screen smartphone officially goes on sale this Friday. It is the third model in Apple's 12th-generation iPhone lineup to get released. The company started selling its high-end iPhone XS and XS Max handsets on Sept. 21.
Nomura Instinet analyst Jeffrey Kvaal said iPhone XR shipment times exiting the weekend were on pace with iPhone 8 Plus levels last year.
"We consider this mildly disappointing (though only mildly) given conjecture consumer buying activity or telco promotions would be higher with the $749 XR," Kvaal said in a report Sunday.

Apple stock rose 0.6% to 220.65 on the stock market today .
IPhone XR Preorders 'Weaker Than Expected' Rosenblatt Securities analyst Jun Zhang said iPhone XR preorders appear weaker than expected.
"IPhone XR preorders have been weaker than our expectations, but slightly better than iPhone XS and iPhone XS Max preorders," Zhang said in a report Monday. "Based on the iPhone XR currently having only one week wait time in China and no wait time in the U.S. and other major markets, we believe XR preorders will equate to less than or equal to 12 million units."
Zhang estimated preorders of 10 million units in the first three days of availability for the iPhone XS series.
He reiterated his buy rating on Apple stock.
